language.title: Welcome to Dr!ve
language.subtitle: Choose your language. You can change it later in Settings.

theme.title: Choose your look
theme.subtitle: Dark like a cockpit at night – or light for the day.

account.title: Compare with friends
account.subtitle: With an account you can compare with friends. Your trips and routes always stay on your phone only.

finish.title: All set
finish.subtitle: Just drive. Dr!ve detects your trip automatically – afterwards you'll find it under “Trips”.

perm.denied: Not allowed. You can change this any time in the iPhone Settings.

location.title: Location: “Always”
location.subtitle: To detect your trips automatically – even when the app is closed – Dr!ve needs your location in the background.
location.b1: Battery-friendly: while parked, Dr!ve only remembers roughly where you are. Precise GPS runs only during a trip.
location.b2: Private: your trips, routes and places stay on your iPhone only and are never uploaded.
location.b3: iOS first asks for “While Using the App”. A bit later iOS asks whether Dr!ve may use your location “Always” – please choose “Change to Always Allow”.
location.limited: You allowed “While Using the App”. Automatic detection needs “Always”. Without it you can only record trips with the button while the app is open.

motion.title: Motion & Fitness
motion.subtitle: Your iPhone's sensors can tell whether you are walking, cycling or in a car. Dr!ve uses this so GPS only runs on real car trips.
motion.b1: Saves battery and keeps bike rides from counting as car trips.
motion.b2: Dr!ve does not read health data, steps or workouts.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Dr!ve sends your weekly recap on Sundays at 6 pm and tells you when you unlock a badge or a friend overtakes you.
notifications.b1: Dr!ve never sends notifications while you drive.

locationWeb.title: Location
locationWeb.subtitle: To detect your trips, this page needs your location. Your browser will ask in a moment.
locationWeb.b1: Everything stays on your phone: location, trips and routes are stored only in this browser and never sent anywhere.
locationWeb.b2: In the browser, detection only runs while the page is open and the screen is on. Fully automatic background detection needs the iPhone app.

week.title: This week
week.emptyText: As soon as you drive, Dr!ve records your trip automatically.

trips.title: Trips
trips.empty: Your trips will appear here, newest first.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: Invite friends with a code or link and compare your week – by distance, trips and streak.

achievements.title: Badges
achievements.text: Unlock badges for distance, streaks and special trips. Never for high speed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyText: Trips, routes and GPS points stay on your phone only.
settings.deleteConfirmText: All trips, routes and logs on this iPhone will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

tracking.androidNotificationBody: Your trip is being detected and saved.
tracking.statusCandidate: Movement detected – checking whether you're driving …
tracking.statusOffHint: Allow location “Always” so trips are detected automatically.
tracking.manualHint: If automatic detection misses a trip, start it here by hand. Dr!ve ends it automatically after 3 minutes standing still.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.simulationHint: Plays a trip through the real detection. Saved trips are marked as simulation.
diagnostics.gpxError: The file could not be read.

web.title: Detect trips in the browser
web.text: Tap “Allow location”. Your browser will ask whether Dr!ve may use your location.
web.private: Everything stays on your phone: location, trips and routes are stored only here in your browser and are never sent anywhere.
web.limit: Important: in the browser this only works while this page is open and the screen is on (e.g. phone in a car mount). Dr!ve keeps the screen awake for this. If the phone locks, detection pauses.

status.denied: Location not allowed. Allow it in iPhone Settings → Safari → Location.
status.unsupported: This browser cannot determine your location.
status.error: No GPS signal. Try again outdoors.

phase.candidate: Movement detected – checking whether you're driving …
